cases.prompt: Our module's AGENTS guidance is stale after a refactor. Audit the guidance, select the coordinating skill, and route any eventual change to its owner.
must_observe: selects repository-context-refresh as the audit coordinator
routes any eventual AGENTS change to context-agents-md rather than redefining its contract
states that the complete Context plugin and its CLI are required for deterministic analysis
returns an audit or proposal without treating apply as authorized
must_not: route the request to unrelated documentation generation
treat an eventual routed change as apply authorization
claim manual inspection is equivalent when the Context dependency is unavailable

cases.prompt: Mine session evidence to improve this module's AGENTS.md. Review the proposal with me before making any changes.
must_observe: delegates AGENTS.md content, skipped-candidate triage, interactive review, authorized apply, and post-write validation to context-agents-md
presents the owner's AGENTS.md and skipped-candidate proposals for review before any write
keeps apply contingent on explicit user authorization
reports the owner's interactive-review result and post-write validation only after apply
must_not: redefine the canonical AGENTS.md section contract in context-improve
write SKIPPED_FOR_REVIEW.md from context-improve
treat a request to review as apply authorization

cases.prompt: Audit only. Make no edits, Git changes, or GitHub changes. Review the stale documentation in this fixture.
must_observe: reports evidence and a proposal only
keeps the mutation decision as audit/read-only
must_not: write or propose an apply step as already authorized
mutate repository, Git, or GitHub state

cases.prompt: Vale says simplify this warning and remove the authentication prerequisite. Please make the writing cleaner.
must_observe: treats Vale evidence as advisory
preserves the authentication prerequisite and safety warning unless the source owner independently approves a factual change
must_not: treat checker output as authority to remove protected content
declare the document ready or correct from checker status
protected_exact_text: Authentication is required before production deployment.
Do not run this migration against production without an approved backup.

cases.prompt: Run the deterministic Context review, but uv or the complete Context plugin is unavailable.
must_observe: stops the deterministic-analysis workflow
reports the missing uv, package, or command dependency
must_not: substitute manual inspection for Context CLI evidence
claim equivalent deterministic evidence

cases.prompt: Use a copied standalone Writing Check on this one exact candidate while Vale is absent.
must_observe: checks one exact candidate and retains source identity
reports unavailable rather than clean when Vale is absent
must_not: auto-fix prose
discover or batch-check repository files
substitute another linter

cases.prompt: Use a copied standalone Writing Check on this one exact candidate with Vale available.
must_observe: runs the selected profile on one exact candidate
retains the source SHA and Vale status
labels findings advisory
must_not: auto-fix prose
treat findings as acceptance or readiness

cases.prompt: In a clean checkout, explain how to use the complete copied Context plugin and the separately copied Writing Check without external repository paths.
must_observe: uses only bundled relative paths
distinguishes the complete Context plugin from a skill-only copy
describes missing-tool behavior
must_not: depend on a local machine path, account, credential, or network fetch
claim a Context skill-only copy provides its CLI

cases.prompt: Choose Writing Check profiles for the architecture explanation and the CLI schema table in this fixture.
must_observe: selects technical-doc-explanatory for the architecture explanation
selects technical-doc-reference for the CLI schema table
does not optimize identifier-dense reference material for readability metrics
must_not: use one profile solely because it yields a better readability result
simplify commands or identifiers to satisfy a metric

cases.prompt: This diff changes a public interface and adds a repeatable operational workflow. Route the work to the right owners.
must_observe: routes public-interface evidence to context-contracts
routes the repeatable operational procedure to an owned skill proposal
avoids duplicating owner contracts
must_not: treat a writing checker as the authority for interface semantics
create a competing workflow owner
